text:
### Verification Checklist  
- [ ] Document received (note date)
- [ ] Document type identified
- [ ] Document date within acceptable range (usually 3 months)
- [ ] Customer name on document matches account
- [ ] Address on document matches new address provided
- [ ] Document is original or certified copy (not photocopy)
- [ ] No signs of tampering
- [ ] Document legibility sufficient to read
- [ ] Verified by second staff member (QA check)
name: Chunk 22/52

raw_entities.name: Document Verification Process
raw_entities.description: A systematic verification procedure for documents submitted during customer onboarding or address updates. The process includes receipt dating, document type identification, temporal validation, customer name matching, address matching, authenticity checks, tampering detection, legibility assessment, and quality assurance review by a second staff member.
context: Document received (note date)
Document type identified
Customer name on document matches account
Verified by second staff member (QA check)

raw_entities.name: Document Receipt and Dating
raw_entities.description: The initial step of recording the date on which a document is received as part of the verification workflow.
context: Document received (note date)

raw_entities.name: Document Type Identification
raw_entities.description: The step of identifying and classifying the type of document submitted for verification.
context: Document type identified

raw_entities.name: Document Date Range Validation
raw_entities.description: Verification that the document date falls within an acceptable range, typically within three months of submission.
context: Document date within acceptable range (usually 3 months)

raw_entities.name: Customer Name Matching
raw_entities.description: Verification that the customer name appearing on the submitted document matches the name recorded on the account.
context: Customer name on document matches account

raw_entities.name: Address Matching
raw_entities.description: Verification that the address shown on the document matches the new address provided by the customer.
context: Address on document matches new address provided

raw_entities.name: Document Authenticity Check
raw_entities.description: Verification that the document is an original or certified copy, not a photocopy, to ensure authenticity.
context: Document is original or certified copy (not photocopy)

raw_entities.name: Tampering Detection
raw_entities.description: Visual inspection of the document to identify any signs of tampering or alteration.
context: No signs of tampering

raw_entities.name: Document Legibility Assessment
raw_entities.description: Verification that the document is legible and all required information can be clearly read.
context: Document legibility sufficient to read

raw_entities.name: Quality Assurance Review
raw_entities.description: A secondary verification step performed by a second staff member to ensure all verification checks have been completed correctly.
context: Verified by second staff member (QA check)

raw_entities.name: Primary Verification Staff
raw_entities.description: The staff member responsible for conducting the initial document verification checks against the verification checklist.
context: Document received (note date)
Document type identified
Customer name on document matches account

raw_entities.name: Quality Assurance Reviewer
raw_entities.description: A second staff member responsible for conducting a quality assurance review to verify that all document verification steps have been properly completed.
context: Verified by second staff member (QA check)

raw_entities.name: Proof of Address Document
raw_entities.description: An official document submitted to verify a customer's address during the verification process. The document must be original or certified, show no signs of tampering, be legible, and have a date within acceptable range.
context: Address on document matches new address provided
Document is original or certified copy (not photocopy)
No signs of tampering
Document legibility sufficient to read

raw_entities.name: Address Verification
raw_entities.description: The verification process ensuring that the address on the submitted document matches the new address provided by the customer during account update or onboarding.
context: Address on document matches new address provided

properties.purpose: Verify authenticity and accuracy of customer identification and address documents
properties.scope: All document verification activities for account opening and address changes
properties.outcome_success: Document verified as authentic, legible, and matching customer details
properties.outcome_failure: Document rejected; customer requested to resubmit or provide alternative proof

properties.input: Physical or scanned document from customer

properties.output: Document type classified (e.g., passport, utility bill, driving licence)
Confirmation that document is within acceptable date range
properties.failure_path: Document rejected if outside acceptable range; customer notified to provide current document

properties.input: Customer name on document; account holder name
properties.output: Confirmation of name match or identification of discrepancy
properties.failure_path: Discrepancy escalated; customer contacted for clarification or alternative document

properties.input: Address on document; new address provided by customer
properties.output: Confirmation of address match or identification of discrepancy
properties.failure_path: Discrepancy escalated; customer contacted for clarification

properties.output: Confirmation that document is original or certified copy, not photocopy
properties.failure_path: Document rejected if photocopy; customer requested to provide original or certified copy

properties.output: Confirmation of absence of tampering signs
properties.failure_path: Document rejected if signs of tampering detected; fraud alert may be raised

properties.output: Confirmation that all required information is legible and readable
properties.failure_path: Document rejected if legibility insufficient; customer requested to resubmit clearer copy

properties.output: QA sign-off confirming all verification steps completed and passed
properties.failure_path: QA rejection returned to Primary Verification Staff for remediation or document rejection

collection_steps: Customer submits document at branch or by post
properties.recording_obligation: Document details recorded in customer file and document tracking system

collection_steps: Customer provides new address during account opening or change of address request
verification_steps: Address on submitted document matched against customer-provided address
properties.recording_system: Customer account system and document tracking system
